sonnet.problem: The card says Jacob lost Joseph "years ago." No time is given in Genesis 42, and the cited verses (37:33; 41:41, 57) don't give one either, so the card adds a time the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

sonnet.problem: The card says the brothers sold Joseph "years ago." The cited verse, Genesis 37:28, gives no span of time, so the card adds a time the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

sonnet.problem: The right answer is the only despairing one. The wrong answers ("God will surely bring Simeon home," "The famine will be over soon") are hopeful and don't fit Jacob's grief, so they aren't believable. The right answer stands out by tone.
sonnet.rule: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. None are silly. ... Don't let the right answer stand out.
